recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Handle any future work on designation-use code choices or contextual designation semantics under later Vocab issues, not as a FHIR-29821 reconciliation change.
issue_request: FHIR-29821 was a Published FHIR-core Vocab change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking not to make designation.use repeat but instead to add CodeSystem.concept.designation.additionalUse and ValueSet.compose.include.concept.designation.additionalUse as 0..* Coding elements, require designation.use when additionalUse is present, and add designation.additionalUse as a $lookup output part.
initial_application: Commit e522c99cebff40f73a3dc10a5673ee5ed6e5b2b8 explicitly applied FHIR-29821 by adding the CodeSystem and ValueSet additionalUse elements, csd-5 and vsd-11 constraints, and the CodeSystem $lookup output part. Later StructureDefinition reformatting preserved those semantics in the current source.
additional_context: ValueSet.expansion.contains.designation is a contentReference to ValueSet.compose.include.concept.designation, so the additionalUse child and invariant are reused for expansion.contains.designation without duplicate child definitions. FHIR-36231 later discussed contextual structure around additionalUse and was resolved No Change; FHIR-57375 is an unresolved later proposal about DesignationUse codes. Neither changes the FHIR-29821 source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scope source already contains all requested FHIR-29821 structures and no corrective source edit is needed.
